keyMappings:
# Insert your preferred key mappings here.
unmap f
map s LinkHints.activateMode

unmap F
map S LinkHints.activateModeToOpenInNewTab

unmap <a-f>
map <a-s> LinkHints.activateModeWithQueue

unmap J
unmap K
map J nextTab
map K previousTab

unmap <c-a>
unmap <c-h>
unmap <c-l>
map <c-h> previousTab
map <c-l> nextTab

unmap d
unmap u
map <c-d> scrollPageDown 
map <c-u> scrollPageUp

map ZZ removeTab

map r reload hard
